fact: On 20 December 2023 the Financial Services Authority, for the Ministry of Finance, launched a public consultation on the proposed Virtual Asset Service Providers framework (VASP Act), inviting written responses and a hybrid live session on 9 January 2024 attended by about 50-60 participants, with extra sessions for Securities Act licensees, corporate service providers and operating VASPs.
